inspection: Read-only NumPy/JSON/gzip/pickle inspection and CPU torch.load of saved checkpoint metadata; no model construction, forward/loss/optimizer computation, simulator, tests or GPU

actual_training_window_analysis.segmentation: One whole learner-run trial per goal, not individual K4 cases; finite random windows start with fresh recurrent state
actual_training_window_analysis.observable_context: First window token still contains the actual immediately preceding noise/reward/done; feedback before that token is absent
actual_training_window_analysis.limitation: Teacher replay/optimizer persist across cases. Full responsible replay-gradient history is not an input; coverage statistics describe observable feedback, not exact reconstruction of SAC learning
